# derivation kind

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:derivationKind`](gmeow-derivationKind.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationKind>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/lexicon`](../../slices/lexicon.md)

The kind(s) of etymological derivation claimed — borrowing, calque, semantic shift, sound change, etc. NON-FUNCTIONAL: a single derivation may be classified as both borrowing and reanalysis by different analytical standpoints ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
